articles.summary: SAN FRANCISCO, Nov. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - iRhythm Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: IRTC), a leading digital health care company with a mission to create trusted solutions that detect, predict, and prevent disease, today reported financial results for the three months ended September 30, 2026. Third Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights Revenue of $221.6 million, a 14.9% increase compared to third quarter 2025 Gross margin of 74.2%, a 310-basis point increase compared to third quarter 2025 GAAP net loss
articles.title: iRhythm Holdings Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

articles.summary: SAN FRANCISCO, Nov. 06, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - iRhythm Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: IRTC), a leading digital health care company with a mission to create trusted solutions that detect, predict, and prevent disease, today announced that it will participate in the following investor conferences. Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference in London on Thursday, November 19, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. GMT (3:00 a.m. PT) 9th Annual Evercore Healthcare Conference on Tuesday, December 1, 2026, at 2:10 p.m. ET (11:10 a.m. PT) Citi’s 2026 Global Healthcare Conference on Wednesday, December 2, 2026, at 1:40 p.m. ET (10:40 a.m. PT) Interested parties may access live and archived webcasts of the presentations on the “Events Presentations” section of the company’s investor website at investors.irhythmtech.com .
